sourceText:
Giant Valentine Cookie
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 12, 2009 - 11:48pm

Ingredients




1 (18-ounce) package refrigerated choc. chip or walnut choc. chip dough
1/2 cup semisweet chocolate chips (3 ounces)

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease a 9 inch heart-shaped pan. 2 Press cookie dough into prepared pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown on top. 3 Cool in pan on wire rack for 10 minutes; remove from pan and cool completely. 4 Microwave chocolate chips in small bowl for 45 seconds; stir. Then microwave in 10-second intervals, stirring until smooth. 5 Carefully spread the melted chocolate over cookie to within 1 inch of the edge.
